users.title: Users
users.description: Who can sign in and which projects each person reaches.
users.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one.
users.deleteDescription: {{email}} loses access at once, and their API keys stop working.
users.deactivateDescription: {{email}} is signed out at once and can't sign in until someone brings the account back. Their API keys are revoked for good.
users.accessHint: Viewers see states and inventory. Operators can also configure and deploy.
users.hostAdminHint: Open a shell on the server, read its disk and reboot it. A service's console stays with administrators.
users.hostAdminOwnerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
users.changeOwnAccount: Change your own on your Authentication page.
users.roleHint: What this account can reach on this server.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Keys act with your rights, limited to the projects and level you choose. Each one is shown once.
keys.name: Name
keys.expiresHint: Days until it stops working, {{max}} at most.
keys.scopeHint: Leave all unchecked for every project you reach.
keys.scopeHintAdmin: Leave all unchecked for every project.
keys.revokeDescription: Anything using {{name}} stops working at once.
keys.shownOnce: Copy it now. It won't be shown again.
keys.emptyDescription: Create one to use the API from a script or a CI job.
keys.nameHint: A name to tell this key apart.
keys.secretHint: Copy it now. It isn't shown again.
